subject: physical-education

masteryInterpretation.secure: At least 85% with controlled independent application, accurate cue use, and adequate explanation.
masteryInterpretation.developing: 70-84% or inconsistent cue use; assign targeted varied practice and a fresh transfer check.
masteryInterpretation.not_yet: Below 70% or a missing prerequisite movement; reteach the simplest version and reassess with new evidence.
masteryInterpretation.rule: A unit score is one evidence source, not the sole basis for long-term mastery. No part of this score may derive from speed, distance, repetition count, body measurement, or comparison with another learner.

accommodationNote: Access supports may change equipment, distance, speed, force, duration, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. Using the adapted alternative is a full-credit path, never a reduced one.

guardianSafetyReview.equipment: Body-weight activity only; water available throughout. No weights, no measurement device, no fitness-test equipment.
guardianSafetyReview.environment: Indoor open space or a supervised outdoor area with shade and water access.
guardianSafetyReview.movement_hazards: Sustained activity raises heart rate and body temperature. Guardian confirms hydration, allows rest at any time, and adjusts for heat, asthma, or any medical guidance already in place.
guardianSafetyReview.food_or_allergy_note: Guardian applies any existing medical guidance for exercise-related asthma, allergy, or condition. The course never asks for the diagnosis itself.
